Restores optimal scalp and hair pH
12-day UV and color defense
Reduces grey hair by up to 30% in 3 months
Adds natural volume and hold without drying
Revitalizing Rice Bio Brew™
A blend of fermented rice water, ginger root, green tea seed, and pomelo rind that cleanses buildup while restoring pH for smoother hair.
Green Walnut PA++ A supercharged protection against colour oxidation/UVB for up to 12 days. 
Anti-Grey Peptide
Peptigrey™ is a peptide-based active ingredient that helps to kickstart melanin production in greying hairs.
